text:
Anna Chen: small design session notes  thinking about keyboard-first + bulk workflows for rule stacks. users with 100+ rules want fast reordering without dragging.
Liam Ortiz: +1. propose multi-select (Shift+click / Cmd+click) and group-move actions (Move group up/down). show a compact badge '3 selected' and ghost-group insertion target.
Sophia Patel: also UX idea: preview heatmap in the simulator that overlays match-density per rule (thin colored bar on the right). helps spot hotspots pre-save. color must have contrast options for colorblind users :eyeglasses:
Derek Li: validation levels: introduce severity (info, warn, error). e.g., overlapping optional clauses => warn; exact signature duplicates => error. UI should show inline severity icon + suggested_fix button.
Jin (designbot): a11y checklist: ensure multi-select state is announced; keyboard moves use Alt+Up/Alt+Down for single and Alt+Shift+Up/Down for multi; heatmap must have non-color legend and numeric tooltip; provide high-contrast palette option.
Harper Q: mobile/compact mode: bulk-select in mobile needs a different affordance (long-press to start selection) and sticky action bar with Move/Lock/Delete. avoid tiny targets.
Liam Ortiz: sample validation API for severity & fix (for engs):
```
{
  "severity": "warn",
  "message": "Overlapping: rule A overlaps rule B",
  "suggested_fix": "Narrow condition or increase priority",
  "affected": ["r-101","r-102"]
}
```
Sophia Patel: copy tweak: change 'Save' to 'Apply changes (draft)' and 'Publish' to make draft vs saved clearer. tooltip: 'Apply to preview only; Publish writes config'.
Derek Li: conflict resolution flow: Add 'Auto-suggest' that proposes minimal condition edits (toggleable). make it explicit and reversible. log suggestions to audit trail.
Anna Chen: OK plan: Liam -> multi-select UI + keyboard group moves + mobile long-press pattern. Sophia -> heatmap visuals + copy changes + non-color legend. Derek -> severity badges, suggested_fix flow, audit logging. Jin -> a11y tests & contrast palette. Harper -> mobile sticky action bar mockups. Sync Friday 9:30am for demos. Thanks :sparkles:
